book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: On the fourth voyage, a strong storm came.
The ship broke and the men drowned.

sentences.ar: طلعت عالشط مع كم واحد بس.
sentences.en: I got to shore with only a few others.
The island’s people received us and gave us food.

sentences.ar: الأكل كان حلو وكتير وغريب الطعم.
sentences.en: The food was sweet and plentiful and strange in taste.

sentences.ar: رفقاتي أكلوا كتير وأنا أكلت شوي.
sentences.en: My companions ate a lot and I ate a little.
After days, they became like madmen.

sentences.ar: ما بقيوا يعرفوا حالهم ولا حكيهم.
sentences.en: They no longer knew themselves or their own speech.
